notes: Account status: closed-lost (2024-08-28) — customer signed with OpenAI direct API for initial rollout.
Why lost: repeated feedback from CTO / platform team: 'we need the fastest path to deploy; brand and existing SDK tooling won this one.'
Procurement timeline: started proof-of-concept 2024-06; POC showed latency and cost within targets but integration velocity was slower than expected compared to competitor SDK demos.
Security review: completed Redwood security Q&A but security flagged vendor unfamiliarity with their enterprise network patterns; not a showstopper but increased perceived risk vs OpenAI.
Champion: product lead (Liam Harper) was enthusiastic early but moved to another internal initiative in July; no fallback champion identified.
Budget: finance implemented a Q4 vendor freeze (email thread attached) — even with ROI case, procurement deprioritized switching to a new provider this year.
Quote from call (CTO): 'We want the path of least friction — fewer moving parts, less to explain to infra and SRE. OpenAI's brand and turnkey SDK reduce organizational friction.'

Technical notes: target SLA was p95 < 250ms for chat inference; POC delivered median 180ms on dedicated nodes but had longer tail under burst traffic; Redwood proposed autoscale + fallback to cheaper model variants, but customer team preferred single-vendor simplicity.
Competitive notes: Anthropic evaluated for safety profile; product team liked Claude for certain moderation patterns but prioritized integration speed over nuanced safety tradeoffs.
Follow-up plan: send short exit survey + security FAQ recap, add to 3-month nurture cadence, flag for re-engagement if they hit scale or need private deployment.
Internal: AE to log lessons-learned in RED-4342; SE recommended adding a 'brand & quickstart' one-pager for future mid-market deals.
